title.en: From a job to a request

hints.tr: Yöntemleri bir sözlükte tut; kimlik `None` ise adres `/books`, değilse `/books/` + kimlik.
hints.en: Keep the methods in a dictionary; if the identifier is `None` the address is `/books`, otherwise `/books/` + the identifier.

checks.expected:
list -> GET /books
read -> GET /books/42
create -> POST /books
change -> PATCH /books/7
remove -> DELETE /books/3
replace -> PUT /books/9
